messages:
ana: Noticed increased mTLS handshake failures from ap-northeast clients to edge-proxy around 2024-11-05T14:10Z. Fail rate ~2.3% on canary.
devops-ci: Did we push any RBAC changes recently for the keystore KMS key? I modified a binding last week for a cross-region test.
sec-keystore-bot: ALERT: KMS Decrypt anomaly on key=keystore-edge-prod at 2024-11-05T13:58Z: principal=svc:ci-runner@infra.example.com; issuer_fingerprint mismatch detected for cert requested by service=mtls-proxy-ap-northeast.
tobias: that principal is our CI runner. which role was granted? Could be temp binding for pipeline.
rach: checking IAM audit: bindRole created 2024-11-04T22:40Z by user:auto-deploy-bot@infra.example.com with note "temp-cross-region-test". Binding allowed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to serviceAccount:ci-runner.
nana: (typo: ana) we need to revoke immediately and rotate any certs that used that key for signing. Also add deny for ci-runner on production keystore until investigation.
devops-ci: revoking now: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding keystore-edge-prod --member="serviceAccount:ci-runner@infra.example.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"`
sec-keystore-bot: NOTE: revoke recorded. Shadow certs issued for mtls-proxy-ap-northeast, canary traffic switched.
tonias: forensics: grep KMS audit for all Decrypt events between 2024-11-04T20:00Z and 2024-11-05T15:00Z and map principal -> CSR IPs. Also capture TLS SNI from proxy logs.
rach: proxy logs show CSR initiated from mtls-proxy pod at 13:57Z with SNI edge.redwood.example and egress to acme-provider.net. But KMS decrypt at 13:58Z shows principal ci-runner. How did CI runner touch the key?
oncall-liz: I'm oncall. I'll escalate if we see evidence of CI secrets leakage. Add legal if customer certs affected.
nana: action list: 1) revoke binding (done) 2) rotate affected certs to shadow (in progress) 3) extend KMS audit retention for key to 90d 4) rotate CI pipeline tokens and rotate any service account keys 5) audit infra-runner logs for token usage 6) run full provenance sweep for other keys with temp bindings last 30 days. Assign Tobias + Rach.
devops-ci: starting pipeline token rotation and CI secrets rotation. posting progress.
tonias: add a blocking rule to deny CI principals from keystore keys via org policy until whitelist is validated.
sec-keystore-bot: NOTE: shadow certs promoted to primary at 2024-11-05T15:30Z unless rollback command posted.
oncall-liz: keeping legal & cs in the loop. I'll monitor for customer anomalies. Post any strange principal reappearance here.
rach: infra audit shows auto-deploy-bot executed terraform apply for a one-off test. it included a `google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding` creation with temp binding. Patching infra templates to require peer review for any KMS IAM changes.
tobias: final: run vuln-triage and label this as "process-gap" unless we see leaked tokens. If we find token use outside infra ip ranges, escalate to incident.
nana: thanks team. keep updates short.
